evals.expected_output: The skill reads both local convention files, uses Atlassian Rovo to list the authenticated user's unfinished assigned issues with due date and Story Points, displays a numbered choice, and after selection runs a read-only Git safety preflight before any Jira mutation. It preserves sufficient Jira context without reconfirmation and asks one compact question only for missing required fields or work context.
expectations: Both docs/team-rules/jira-convention.md and docs/team-rules/git-convention.md are read before any mutation.
Jira identity and issue search use Atlassian Rovo.
The user can select by number or title without typing a Jira key.
No branch, Jira description, or Jira status is changed before explicit selection.
After selection, repository, branch, worktree, branch conflicts, and develop availability are checked without mutation before any Jira edit.
A compact question asks only for missing intended change, observable completion result, due date, or allowed Story Points.
No confirmation question is asked when the existing description and mandatory fields are already sufficient.

evals.prompt: 진행 중인 작업 이어서 하자. 현재 브랜치가 fix/S15P11B104-124-network-error이고 커밋하지 않은 작업이 있어.
evals.expected_output: The skill offers the in-progress issue first, verifies or minimally completes its Jira description through Atlassian Rovo, reuses the already valid matching branch without discarding current changes, leaves the Jira status unchanged, reports the prepared context, and stops before planning or implementation.
expectations: The existing Jira description is preserved while missing work context is added when needed.
The single assignee, due date, and Story Points from 1, 2, 3, 5, or 8 are verified before Git mutation.
The valid matching branch is reused instead of recreated.
Existing uncommitted changes are preserved for the resume operation.
An already-in-progress Jira issue is not transitioned again.
The output stops at the next step of implementation planning.

evals.prompt: 내 Jira 작업 시작해줘. 그런데 로컬 Jira Convention 문서를 읽을 수 없는 상황이라고 가정해.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports that the authoritative local Jira convention is unavailable and stops without creating or switching a branch and without changing Jira.
expectations: The skill does not reconstruct or guess the missing Jira convention.
No Git mutation is performed.
No Jira mutation is performed.
The response reports the unavailable convention source concisely.

evals.prompt: 2번 티켓으로 할게. 기존 설명에는 기획 링크가 있어. 로그인 실패 원인을 사용자에게 보여주고 재시도할 수 있게 바꾸면 끝이야. 빠진 Story Points는 3으로 해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill first confirms through a read-only Git preflight that branch preparation is safe, then treats the user's sentence as sufficient work context and explicit Story Points, preserves the existing planning link, updates only the missing Story Points and description through Atlassian Rovo, verifies mandatory fields, and only then proceeds to branch preparation and the In Progress transition.
expectations: A read-only Git safety preflight succeeds before Jira is edited.
The provided sentence is accepted without forcing a form or asking for implementation details.
The existing planning link and unrelated Jira description content are preserved.
The Jira description contains both the intended change and an observable completion result.
Story Points are set to 3 only if they were missing or invalid.
The updated issue is fetched again to verify description, one assignee, due date, and Story Points before any Git or Jira status mutation.
A failed description update stops the workflow before branch preparation or status transition.

evals.prompt: 1번 티켓으로 시작해줘. 담당자, 기한, Story Points가 모두 있고 기존 설명에도 바꿀 내용과 완료 기준이 충분히 적혀 있어.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs a read-only Git safety preflight, preserves the sufficient Jira description and policy fields without asking for confirmation or editing the issue, prepares or reuses the valid branch, and transitions the issue only when needed.
expectations: Git safety is checked without mutation before any possible Jira edit.
No question asks whether to keep or supplement the already sufficient description.
No Jira issue edit is performed because no field or description change is needed.
The existing description, assignee, due date, and Story Points are preserved.
Branch preparation and the In Progress transition proceed only after the record and Git preflight are verified.

evals.prompt: 2번 티켓으로 시작해줘. 지금은 다른 Jira 티켓 브랜치에 커밋하지 않은 변경사항이 있어서 브랜치를 바꿀 수 없어.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects during the read-only Git preflight that branch switching is unsafe and stops before editing Jira, changing Git, or transitioning status.
expectations: The current branch and uncommitted work are inspected without mutation.
No Jira description, due date, Story Points, or status is changed.
No branch is created, switched, renamed, or deleted.
The report identifies the unsafe worktree as the blocker and does not leave a Jira-only partial result.

evals.prompt: 목록의 '[FE] 통화 리포트 조회 화면 구현' 작업으로 시작해줘. 담당자, 기한, Story Points와 설명은 모두 유효하고 아직 브랜치는 없어.
evals.expected_output: The skill accepts the allowed Task prefix, derives a clean branch slug without copying `[FE]`, prepares the branch after the safety preflight, and transitions only the selected issue.
expectations: The live Jira issue type remains authoritative and the `[FE]` marker is treated only as Task scope metadata.
The valid current-policy title is not renamed or edited.
The branch slug excludes brackets and the literal `FE` marker while preserving the Jira key and meaningful English work name.
The usual assignee, due date, Story Points, description, Git safety, and transition gates still apply.

evals.prompt: 목록의 '중간발표 자료 정리' 작업으로 시작해줘. 영역 분할과 무관한 단일 작업이고 필수 필드와 설명은 모두 유효해.

expectations: A standalone planning or presentation Task is valid without a domain prefix.
The Jira summary is not renamed or given an invented prefix.
The normal assignee, due date, Story Points, description, Git safety, branch, and transition rules still apply.

evals.prompt: 목록의 '[COMMON] 보호자는 가족 리포트를 확인할 수 있다' 스토리로 시작해줘. 현재 제목 정책 이후 생성된 티켓이야.

No Jira summary edit, branch mutation, or status transition occurs.

evals.prompt: 목록의 '[COMMON] 중간발표 자료 정리' 작업으로 시작해줘. 단일 영역의 standalone 작업이고 현재 제목 정책 이후 생성됐어.
